items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Because Bro kicked about because of the drum. Bro, Sonny Grimm. He's opposite. It's a pull between the rhythm section. See, I'm going this way and you're going the other way. Cause of contrast.

ctx.x: And Baby Dots. take my boy there. I'm not mad at him. Baby Dots. And Baby Dots, if drummers would read music like Baby Dots, and these folks I'm telling you about, young boys that's coming up, Bill is never going to knock anybody higher. But if they're going to try to knock that drum head, that bass drum front head to the back head, the way they're kicking them drums nowadays all that noise, they're not going any places. I'm telling you, they're not going any places, no further than the air. It's too bad to see…
Well, there's a couple other fellas here on the list. Joe Oliver, can you tell us what kind of a fella he was?
